school.school_name: 新潟デザイン専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a target confirmation form from an information page with many adjacent PDF disclosures.
search_queries: 新潟デザイン専門学校 情報公開
新潟デザイン専門学校 機関要件確認申請書様式第2号
steps: Open the school information disclosure page.
Locate section 3 修学支援制度.
Reject adjacent links for 学科設置表, 実務経験のある教員等による授業科目, 役員名簿, and 成績分布.
Choose the link labeled 機関要件確認申請書様式第2号.
Use the filename confirm2025.pdf and PDF body school name to confirm the FY2025 target form.

reusable_rules: On structured 情報公開 pages, prefer the 修学支援制度 section before scanning all PDFs.
Use anchor labels containing 機関要件確認申請書 or 様式第2号 as primary target signals.
Use filename year hints like confirm2025.pdf only after rejecting adjacent disclosure PDFs in the same section.
anti_patterns: Do not send board.pdf or practice.pdf as target candidates even though they are in the same support directory.
Do not treat 学科設置表 as the target form; it is only an adjacent support-system artifact.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-11 found the target link under 修学支援制度 and verified the PDF body contains 新潟デザイン専門学校 and 様式第２号.
